edits.label: Reconciliation writes use trusted broker
Retired document metadata helper docVaultUpload
edits.before:
function docVaultUpload(staffId, kind, data) {
      return docVaultEnabled() && docVaultOwn(staffId) && docVaultKind(kind)
        && data.keys().hasOnly(['staffId', 'branch', 'group', 'uploadId', 'uploadedByUid',
          'storagePath', 'contentType', 'size', 'sha256', 'clearanceType', 'expiresOn', 'status',
          'reviewNote', 'version', 'uploadedAt', 'updatedAt'])
        && data.staffId == staffId
        && data.branch == readData('staff_document_devices',reqUid()).branch && data.group == kind
        && docVaultId(data.uploadId) && data.uploadedByUid == reqUid()
        && data.storagePath == 'staff_private_documents/' + reqUid() + '/' + staffId + '/' + kind + '/' + data.uploadId + '.jpg'
        && data.contentType == 'image/jpeg' && data.size is int && data.size > 0 && data.size <= 2097152
        && data.sha256 is string && data.sha256.matches('^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
        && data.clearanceType is string
        && ((kind == 'clearance' && data.clearanceType in ['NBI', 'POLICE'])
          || (kind != 'clearance' && data.clearanceType == ''))
        && data.expiresOn is string && (data.expiresOn == '' || data.expiresOn.matches('^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$'))
        && data.status == 'pending_review' && data.reviewNote == ''
        && data.version is int && data.version > 0
        && data.uploadedAt == reqTime() && data.updatedAt == reqTime();
    }
